searches.exhaustion_conclusion: Bureau Veritas's own Euronext Paris listing record confirms it is the one classification society in this field organised as ordinary listed equity rather than a foundation, mutual, or state body, corroborating the first search's finding from the official-exchange side.

link_scope.qualification_boundary: Public legal issuers that are themselves an internationally recognised classification society issuing Polar Class or ice-class notations, or that directly own such a society as a subsidiary; class societies organised as foundations, mutuals, or state bodies with no listed equity do not qualify even where they are the market leader.

combined_search_scope.qualification_boundary: Public legal issuers that are themselves an internationally recognised classification society issuing Polar Class or ice-class notations, or that directly own such a society as a subsidiary; class societies organised as foundations, mutuals, or state bodies with no listed equity do not qualify even where they are the market leader.
combined_search_scope.coverage_statement: A primary-issuer source (Bureau Veritas's own Polar Rules page, cross-checked against every other IACS member's public identity) and an official exchange record (Euronext Paris) corroborate the same finding from two independent angles: Bureau Veritas alone among class societies is ordinary listed equity.

link_coverage.note: The chain's own example ticker (voestalpine, VOE.VI) is a plausible ice-grade-plate supplier, but this run did not build a dated placement or run a census search for this link; left OPEN rather than padded. A future run should also weigh SSAB (Sweden) and Nippon Steel/JFE Steel (Japan), both named in general Arctic/offshore steel-grade reporting, against dated role evidence before counting them.

The chain's own example tickers (Spire Global SPIR, Iridium IRDM) already have market files or are readily fetchable, and Planet Labs (PL) is a plausible third candidate for optical ice/vessel monitoring, but this run did not build dated role-evidence placements or a formal census for this link; left OPEN.

MOSTLY_PRIVATE by the chain's own classification: the US, Canadian and Finnish icebreaker programme runs mostly through private shipyards (Bollinger Shipyards; Davie/Helsinki Shipyard, per the chain's map_limitation a single private Canadian ownership group). No public shipyard issuer was identified this session; left OPEN rather than forced onto a component supplier already counted on ice-class-propulsion-systems or polar-grade-steel-plate, which would double-count the same bill of materials.

MOSTLY_PRIVATE by the chain's own classification, and this run did not research it: Arctic LNG terminal loading-berth and ice-protection construction in Russia is largely performed by sanctioned or unlisted domestic contractors post-2022, with no dated evidence gathered this session on any surviving listed Western marine-construction contractor's role. Left OPEN.

UNINVESTABLE by the chain's own classification (the chain notes the largest Chinese carrier, COSCO, has publicly avoided the route; the operators that do run it are mostly small private Chinese/Korean lines per the chain's map_limitation). This run did not search for a possible smaller listed operator; left OPEN.

The demand anchor: diffuse by construction (many importing states, utilities and trading houses), LOW bottleneck per the chain's own scoring, and explicitly deprioritised by this run's money-corner/CHOKE_POINT-first census order. Left OPEN.

changelog.change: run universe arctic-sea-route (DEPTH mode, outside the campaign slate): first mapping for this chain, written directly to ACTIVE status. The chain's heat is not yet scored (heat_as_of null on every link), so this run followed the chain's own notes[] pointer (atlas-cartographer, 2026-09-13: 'surfaces polar-marine-hull-and-war-risk-insurance as the strongest money-corner candidate on cited pricing power') for money-corner priority, then closed every CHOKE_POINT link, then the HIGH-bottleneck classification link, leaving MEDIUM/LOW-bottleneck and MOSTLY_PRIVATE/UNINVESTABLE links OPEN with a note rather than researched. polar-marine-hull-and-war-risk-insurance (money-corner candidate) closes TARGET_MET with 5 distinct listed issuers (Beazley, Lancashire Holdings, Chubb, Markel, Allianz), three sourced from Lloyd's List's dated 2025 top-10 marine insurers ranking and two from the issuers' own product/consortium announcements. ice-class-propulsion-systems (CHOKE_POINT) closes EXHAUSTED at 4 of the 5-issuer target (ABB, Wartsila, Kongsberg Gruppen, GE Vernova), with a full multi-source record: a SEC EDGAR registry search plus trade-press coverage of Kongsberg's September 2026 acquisition of the market-leading private specialist Steerprop, which the chain's own bottleneck note already flagged as consolidation rather than organic growth. russian-arctic-lng-export (CHOKE_POINT) closes EXHAUSTED at 4 of 5 (Novatek, CNOOC, TotalEnergies, Mitsui): TotalEnergies exited Arctic LNG 2 in August 2026 (transferring its 10% to NordLine, a Novatek subsidiary) but retains 20% of the older Yamal LNG terminal, so this link's chain-level example ticker (TTE.PA) is preserved but its placement basis moved from Arctic LNG 2 to Yamal LNG; CNPC's stake sits inside an unlisted subsidiary (CNODC) and JOGMEC is a Japanese government agency, so neither adds a public issuer. nsr-transit-control-and-escort and russian-arctic-shipbuilding (both CHOKE_POINT, UNINVESTABLE) were researched but left OPEN at 0 issuers rather than closed EXHAUSTED: this session confirmed Rosatom is a shareholder-less Russian State Corporation (appointed NSR infrastructure operator in 2018) and that Zvezda Shipbuilding Complex was founded by a Rosneft-led consortium never itemised by stake (a 2024-2025 merger into the unlisted United Shipbuilding Corporation was announced then cancelled), matching the chain's own map_limitation naming both as unlisted by design, but every fetchable source for each this session resolved to the same domain (en.wikipedia.org) after rosatom.ru, tass.com topic pages, and several Arctic-policy outlets returned connection errors, 403s or 404s, short of EXHAUSTED's two-distinct-domain bar; both link_coverage rows carry a dated note naming exactly what was confirmed and what a later pass needs (a second, differently-domained source) to close formally. ice-class-classification-and-notation (HIGH) closes EXHAUSTED at 1 of 5 (Bureau Veritas): every other class society that publishes Polar Class rules (DNV, ABS, Lloyd's Register, ClassNK, RINA, CCS, Korean Register, RMRS) is a foundation, non-profit, private group, or state body, a structural feature of the classification industry rather than a research gap. The remaining 6 links (polar-grade-steel-plate, arctic-satellite-ice-monitoring, allied-polar-icebreaker-buildout, arctic-lng-terminal-construction, nsr-container-and-multipurpose-shipping, asia-europe-arctic-trade-demand) are left OPEN at 0 placements with a dated note naming the chain's own example tickers as unresearched candidates for a future pass, per this run's explicit scope: money-corner and CHOKE_POINT links first, then as far as the evidence bar held. 14 distinct issuers across 18 placements, all newly established this session with fresh dated identity_evidence (SEC EDGAR for US filers; each issuer's own official exchange or investor-relations page for ABB, Wartsila, Kongsberg, Allianz, Novatek, CNOOC, Mitsui and Bureau Veritas) and fresh dated role evidence; three listings (CHUBB, GE-VERNOVA, LANCASHIRE-HOLDINGS) reuse identity_evidence verbatim from data/mappings/hormuz-maritime.json and data/mappings/ai-infrastructure.json for the same legal issuer, per the same-issuer reuse rule. market_ticker was set on every non-US listing so the fetcher resolves the correct exchange-suffixed symbol (e.g. NVTK.ME, 00883.HK as 0883.HK, 8031.T, BVI.PA, TTE.PA); request rows were queued for the four placed tickers with no existing market file (NVTK.ME, 0883.HK, 8031.T, BVI.PA). No issuer, listing, placement, or search was invented; every fact traces to a fetched, dated source, and every shortfall against the 5-issuer target is stated as a structural or tooling finding rather than papered over. Mapping left ACTIVE per method 6A; the author never marks its own work COMPLETE.

notes.text: This is a first-pass DEPTH census on a chain outside the campaign slate, built before run heat has scored any link, so 'money-corner' priority here follows the chain's own notes[] pointer (the impact appraisal's money read plus the chain author's own stated expectation that polar-marine-hull-and-war-risk-insurance is the strongest money-corner candidate) rather than a computed money_corner flag. Once run heat scores this chain, a future run universe should re-check that this run's priority order (insurance, then the four CHOKE_POINT links, then classification) still matches the scored verdicts and money_corner flags, and extend census to any newly-flagged UNDISCOVERED link among the six left OPEN here.
